summary: Provided semantic_judgments for the accepted cover unit (湖南农业大学本科毕业论文封面模板). Each source entry is partitioned in document order into parts whose role and (where applicable) field_id are chosen from the supplied vocabulary. The cover layout spans university name (fixed), document-type title (fixed), Chinese/English title placeholders (thesis.title.zh, thesis.title.en), five basic-information lines (author.name.zh, author.student_id, author.cohort_class, advisor.name.zh + advisor.title, author.department), location (fixed), and submission date (submission.date). All embedded font/format/size parenthetical notes are judged as style_only (kept as formatting requirements on their owning content, not as fill values). The leading 附件1 封面基本格式 preamble is judged as style/format context covering the cover layout and is kept as style_only description; it is not emitted as its own unit. No cleanup candidates were identified because every visible fragment carries a binding responsibility to the cover (label, placeholder, or required format).

parts.text: 附件1 封面基本格式：单倍行距；上下页边距均为2.54厘米，左右页边距均为2.6厘米；除基本信息的5行内容外，其余内容均居中。“□” 表示占1个字宽（即2个字符）的空格。所做的为论文,则标题中设计不要；所做的为设计,则标题中标题中论文不要。

semantic_judgments.reason: Pre-unit format preamble outside the cover layout itself; describes required page margins, line spacing, alignment, the meaning of □ spacing, and the 论文 vs 设计 title alternation rule. Treated as style/format context for the cover unit, not as fillable content. Not emitted as a separate unit per accepted boundary.
open_questions: Verify whether the host style contract needs an explicit hook for the 论文/设计 title alternation rule; current semantic judgment only keeps the rule as a style obligation on thesis.title.zh / thesis.title.en.

semantic_judgments.reason: Layout/format instruction that one blank line with 一号华文行楷 must precede the university name; constraints the spacing and font baseline before 湖 南 农 业 大 学, not a fillable value.

parts.text: 湖 南 农 业 大 学

semantic_judgments.reason: University name is a school-fixed brand line; the trailing parenthetical names the required font/size/weight for that line and is style-only. The text itself stays as fixed_label, not a fill slot.

parts.text: 全日制普通本科生毕业论文(设计)

semantic_judgments.reason: School-fixed document-type heading; the parenthetical is the font/size/weight requirement for this line. Per the preamble rule, the (论文) or (设计) suffix is removed depending on work type; this alternation belongs to a host style/format obligation, not to an automatic fill here.
Blank-line and font instruction between the document-type title and the Chinese thesis title; style-only.

parts.text: 毕业论文（设计）中文题目

semantic_judgments.reason: Position occupying the Chinese thesis title in the cover layout. Binds to thesis.title.zh; the parenthetical sets font/size/weight for that field. The 论文 vs 设计 alternation from the preamble still applies, but that alternation is a host style obligation, not a separate fill here.
Position occupying the English thesis title. The host template convention caps in uppercase Times New Roman; the parenthetical sets font/size/weight/casing. Binds to thesis.title.en.

parts.text: （根据题目长短四号字空二或三行）

semantic_judgments.reason: Layout rule: blank rows sized in 四号 between the titles and the basic-information block, depending on title length; style-only.

First basic-information line. The leading □□□□□□ is layout spacing defined by the preamble; kept as style_only. 学生姓名 label is kept; the parenthetical after 学生姓名 sets label font/size/weight; the colon stays; the ×××（或×□×） placeholder occupies the student name value and binds to author.name.zh; the trailing parenthetical sets the value font/size/weight.

Student ID line. The label 学□□号 (interior □ chars belong to the fixed label glyph shape) stays; the colon stays; the 20××… placeholder occupies the student ID value and binds to author.student_id. The leading □□□□□□ before 学□□号 is part of the fixed label region rather than a separate style slot because it visually prefixes the label text on this single line.

Cohort/major/class line. The label is a school-fixed compound label; the colon stays; the placeholder occupies one composite value. The vocabulary provides author.cohort_class whose meaning is exactly the 复合信息 (年级、专业、班级) used here, so it binds as a single fill_slot.

Advisor and title line. The label and colon stay; ××× is the advisor name value (advisor.name.zh); the □ between name and 职称 is spacing per the preamble rule, kept as style_only; 教授 is the title value and binds to advisor.title. The vocabulary does not allow binding the example 职称 placeholder to advisor.name.zh, so it is split into two distinct fill_slots.

Department line. Label and colon stay; ××××学院 occupies the full department name and binds to author.department; the trailing parenthetical is a style/usage note (use full department name), kept as style_only.
Blank-row and font instruction between the basic-information block and the location/date area; style-only.
School location is fixed brand text; the parenthetical sets font/size/weight for that line.
Submission date line. Label and colon stay; the 20××年××月 placeholder occupies the submission date value and binds to submission.date. No font parenthetical appears on this line.
